prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right partner depends on your goals, industry, budget and whether you need enterprise data engineering, creative+personalization, programmatic performance, or in‑house model development. I can, however, help you find the best fit.

Quick questions so I can recommend a short, focused list:
- What’s your primary objective? (brand creative, paid performance, personalization, content automation, recommendation engines, media buying, analytics/attribution, etc.)
- Company size and budget range?
- Any vertical focus or compliance requirements (e.g., healthcare, finance)?
- Timeline (pilot vs long-term engagement)?

If you want general options now, here are reputable Los Angeles–area options grouped by strength — pick based on what you need:

- Enterprise-scale + deep data/AI teams
  - Accenture Interactive / Deloitte Digital / Publicis Sapient — good if you need large-scale data engineering, ML ops, enterprise integrations, or global campaigns.

- Creative + product + AI integration
  - R/GA — known for blending creative, product and technology; good for campaigns that need AI-driven creative/personalization.
  - AKQA — creative and experience design with strong tech integration.

- Performance / social / growth marketing with AI-driven optimization
  - VaynerMedia — strong on social, performance and data-driven creative testing.

- Digital production & technical implementation
  - MediaMonks — strong in digital production, martech integrations and delivering scalable experiences.

- AI-first ad / media technology
  - Veritone (SoCal) — an AI platform company specializing in media analytics, content intelligence and programmatic optimization (good if you need media-level AI tooling).

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
- Clear case studies with metrics (ROI, lift, CPA reduction) for relevant use cases
- Data science and engineering capabilities (in-house ML engineers vs contractors)
- Tech stack compatibility and access to APIs / data sources
- Approach to experimentation (A/B testing, holdouts) and measurement
- Data governance, privacy & security practices
- Team composition and seniority (you want experienced ML/product leads)
- Price model and pilot option with success criteria
- Client references you can call

If you share your goals, budget and timeline, I’ll:
- narrow this to 3–5 LA agencies tailored to you,
- suggest specific questions to ask each in an RFP or discovery call,
- and draft a short 30–minute call script you can use.

Which route do you want to take?
